tr_notice_head.en: About the hosted copy of the original

tr_notice.zh: 原曲《Death Piano》由 Xi 創作，著作權歸原作者所有。本頁自載的原曲音檔有兩個用途：一是 YouTube 嵌入無法播放時的備援，二是提供原曲與採譜成果的左右聲道對照互動體驗（實驗性質）。僅供對照，不作營利、不提供下載。權利人若希望移除，請透過站內「{contact}」來信，收到即下架。
tr_notice.en: "Death Piano" is composed by Xi; all rights to the original remain with its author. The copy hosted here serves two purposes: a fallback when the YouTube embed cannot play, and an experimental left/right-channel comparison between the original and the transcription. It is for comparison only, not monetized, and cannot be downloaded. Rights holders who wish it removed: please write via the site's "{contact}" app and it will be taken down on receipt.

tr_notice_note.zh: 這是為求對照體驗的備用方案，不是主要播放來源；主要來源仍是 YouTube 嵌入。
tr_notice_note.en: A fallback kept for the comparison experience, not the primary source — the YouTube embed remains the primary source.

tr_tip.zh: 聲音沒有對齊嗎？用右手邊的「對齊」調整誤差值。如果真的束手無策，請點擊「使用暫存音源」。
tr_tip.en: Sound out of sync? Use “Align” on the right to adjust the offset. If nothing helps, click “Use the cached copy”.

zh: IraStoria，作曲與遊戲音訊設計者。長期關注「音樂如何回應互動」：不是把音樂貼在畫面上，而是讓音樂本身有結構地跟著玩家的節奏走。
目前同時在做一款節奏遊戲與自製的 DAW／製譜工具。這個網站收錄作品、可操作的概念展示，以及零散的筆記。
en: IraStoria — composer and game audio designer. My long-running interest is how music responds to interaction: not pasting music onto a screen, but letting the music itself follow the player's rhythm in a structured way.
I am currently working on a rhythm game and a home-grown DAW / notation tool. This site collects works, hands-on concept demos, and scattered notes.

click._note: click-to-enter easter egg (fires with probability `chance`). Full-screen boot: x/y = viewport position (centre, nudged right). sound_at = video time where the sound's onset lands. clip plays → vanishes → after_ms → desktop loads.

boot._note: plays when the boot screen appears IF the browser allows sound without a gesture (returning visitors / engaged origins); otherwise it plays on the boot click instead
